exposure: Misoprostol use for second-trimester miscarriage management
Route of misoprostol administration (vaginal vs. sublingual)
outcome: Need for surgical evacuation of retained products of conception
cohort: The study included 90 women with a history of one previous cesarean section undergoing medical management for second-trimester miscarriage.
finding: Misoprostol achieved a complete expulsion rate of 67.7% and was found to successfully and safely conclude second-trimester miscarriages in women with one prior cesarean birth, with the sublingual route showing a significantly shorter induction to termination time.
